title: Reduced Order Modeling of One-Dimensional Conservative PDEs via the Cumulative Distribution Transform
summary: We propose a reduced order modeling (ROM) framework for 1D conservative PDEs based on the cumulative distribution transform (CDT). The CDT maps nonnegative, equal-mass states into a Hilbert space in which 1D Wasserstein distances become weighted $L^2$ distances and translations become affine shifts. This makes the transform especially suited for transport-dominated dynamics, where Eulerian linear-subspace ROMs often suffer from slow decay of Kolmogorov widths.
